title: Run the fund back office
summary: The running fund's money loop: capital calls issued and the wires verified, the management fee charged, and each investment booked on the fund ledger.

parts.title: Issue a capital call notice to the LPs
parts.guidance: Calculate the capital call from the fund agreement, purpose and commitment schedule, applying side letters, exclusions and the relevant due date. Verify the fund’s payment instructions. The authorized GP approves the call amounts and notices before they are issued to investors. Track the resulting obligations against receipts and remaining unfunded commitments.

parts.title: LPs send the capital call wires
parts.guidance: Send investors the GP-authorized call and a trusted way to verify the fund’s payment instructions. Resolve administrative questions through the fund contact and refer changes in amount or timing to the GP. Each investor’s authorized payer releases its own wire. Track remittance information while keeping promised payments distinct from funds actually received.

parts.title: Verify the capital call wires received
parts.guidance: Match bank credits to capital calls by investor, amount, currency and reference. Resolve fees, shortfalls, unexpected senders and excess payments with the administrator before allocating receipts. Update capital accounts and unfunded commitments from the reconciled amounts, and give the GP the unpaid or ambiguous items requiring action.

parts.title: Charge the management fee
parts.guidance: Calculate the management fee from the executed fund documents and side letters using the applicable base, rate, period, offsets, waivers and step-downs. Reconcile it to earlier fees. The GP or designated approver authorizes the charge or payment, after which finance posts the transaction to the correct fund and recipient entities with the calculation attached.

parts.title: Book the investment on the fund ledger
parts.guidance: Book the investment from executed transaction documents, funding evidence and the approved allocation. Identify the portfolio company, security, cost, currency and effective date, applying the administrator’s treatment of fees. Reconcile cash and holdings, keeping subsequent valuation adjustments separate from original cost so investor reporting can trace the position and its movements.

metadata.supportReason: The capital-call notices, wire checks, fee transfer, and ledger booking run over APIs with GP approval gates; the only human part is waiting on the LPs' wires.
